# Brushable Histogram

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

Keep rows whose column lies in a brushed range, drawn over the column's histogram in the parameter pane. Drag the brush, or keyframe its ends to animate it. Bins is a table of the histogram.
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{ "id": "n1", "op": "brushable-histogram", "name": "brushable-histogram", "x": 0, "y": 0, "params": {} }
```

An edge into it ends at `"targetPort": "in"`; one out of it starts at `"sourcePort": "out"`; a parameter is set in `params` (leave out the ones at their default), driven by an edge to `par:binCount`, or read elsewhere as `ch('brushable-histogram/binCount')`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

## Inputs

<!-- gen:begin inputs -->
| Port | Type | Takes |
|------|------|-------|
| `in` | `table` | one edge |
<!-- gen:end inputs -->

## Parameters

<!-- gen:begin params -->
| Parameter | Kind | Default | Choices |
|-----------|------|---------|---------|
| `column` | `column` | `""` |  |
| `binCount` | `int` | `20` |  |
| `brushMin` | `float` | `0` |  |
| `brushMax` | `float` | `100` |  |
| `brushMode` | `menu` | `"handles"` | `handles`, `offset` |
<!-- gen:end params -->

## Outputs

<!-- gen:begin outputs -->
| Port | Type |
|------|------|
| `out` | `table` |
| `bins` | `table` |
<!-- gen:end outputs -->
